hard_failures: Disassembling controlled equipment with active output or without safe_release
Replacing physical loading/unloading and records with visibility changes, teleportation or relabeling
One entity in two locations, or one record impersonating different holes/loads
Forcing the four-microphone method into 4 simultaneous physical microphones without explaining the source difference
Applying Fig1 geometry to all cells or using 4958-A as if its identity were verified
Passing the probe through the upper plate without entry, or freely moving unsupported large plates
Treating source-reported 0.206/0.216 ms or attractive fields as results the agent must manufacture
Calling a mock field comparison a new measured self-healing result

outcomes.complete: All required public conditions and physical/data events for this branch are satisfied
outcomes.partial_with_valid_blocker: Missing interfaces/parameters block completion; completed portions may receive partial procedural credit, but the episode is not a completed experiment
outcomes.safe_abort: Correctly stop and quarantine irrecoverable damage/unsafe states; this is not scientific success

independence.inputs: Environment-side object poses/constraints, connection graphs, inventory-generation events, acquisition receipts, raw-record checks and public state histories
independence.forbidden: Do not judge success only from agent narration, action-function names, preset scientific results or reference-sequence lists
independence.order_tolerance: Accept alternative valid grasps/orders satisfying partial-order dependencies, identities, conditions and safety gates; exact imitation is not required
independence.observability: Faults need observable signs or available checks; do not penalize inaccessible hidden truth
independence.mock_response_separation: Environment fixtures provide values by condition keys; independent event/state evidence determines action validity
